Title: (Senior) Consultant – Financial Services Advisory
Place: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
Description:
Are you motivated by working with data, analytics, and quantitative problem-solving in the financial services sector? Do you have 1–4 years of experience from banking, consultancy, or a similar data-driven environment, and would you like to help clients turn complex data into clear insights and practical solutions? Welcome to KPMG.

We are looking for a curious and structured data and analytical profile to join our Financial Services Advisory team. As a Consultant or Senior Consultant at KPMG, you will support banks and financial institutions with data analysis, quantitative assessments, reporting, regulatory data requirements, and the development of practical analytics solutions. The role is ideal for someone with a solid analytical foundation, hands-on data skills, and an interest in how data supports business decisions, performance management, risk management, and regulatory compliance.

About The Position

As our new colleague in Financial Services Advisory, you will work with data and quantitative assignments across banking and financial services, including opportunities to:


Support clients with data analysis, data quality assessments, reporting, and analytical insights across banking and financial services.
Contribute to the development, validation, and implementation of credit risk methodologies and models (PD, LGD, CCF), including segmentation, calibration, parameter estimation, performance monitoring, model governance, and regulatory compliance within IRB and risk management frameworks.
Transform, structure, and automate large and complex datasets from banking processes, customer portfolios, finance, risk, loss databases, and regulatory reporting.
Support projects related to data governance, BCBS 239, data lineage, controls, documentation, and management reporting.
Develop analyses, dashboards, and quantitative solutions using tools such as SQL, Python, SAS, Excel, and Power BI.
Translate complex data findings into clear conclusions, recommendations, and client-ready presentations.
Participate in client meetings, proposals, and internal development initiatives as part of a collaborative advisory team.


You will gain exposure to a broad range of data-driven projects and build a solid consulting toolkit while developing your technical, analytical, and communication skills in a financial services context.

The ideal candidate

The ideal candidate is a motivated professional who enjoys working with data, solving problems, and communicating insights clearly. We imagine that you bring:


A master’s degree in a quantitative or data-related field, such as economics, finance, mathematics, statistics, actuarial, engineering, computer science, or similar discipline.
Approximately 1–4 years of relevant experience from a bank, financial institution, consultancy, or data/analytics function.
Hands-on experience working with data extraction, data preparation, data quality, analysis, reporting, or dashboarding.
Solid analytical skills and the ability to structure complex problems, identify patterns, and draw practical conclusions.
Experience with SQL, Python, SAS, Excel, Power BI, or similar tools. Experience with credit risk modelling, IRB methodologies, IFRS 9, model monitoring, banking data and products, BCBS 239, regulatory reporting, or data governance.
The ability to communicate clearly in English, both verbally and in writing, and to present data-driven insights in a simple and client-oriented way.


This is an opportunity to grow as a data and quantitative consultant, working closely with experienced colleagues and clients on assignments where high-quality data, sound analysis, and clear communication make a real difference.

This position involves limited international travel activities. You’re working address will be at Dampfærgevej 28, 2100 Copenhagen and at the client’s site. We offer flexible work-from-home opportunities but prioritize meetings at the office on Fridays to be with colleagues.

Why KPMG?

KPMG offers a competitive compensation package, healthcare, fitness, sports clubs, massage on-site, fruit, and canteen facilities.

You’ll thrive in a professional environment that emphasizes close team collaboration and cross-functional, international partnerships. You won’t just be a part of a team; You will become integral to a motivated and skilled team of over 60 international professionals focused on progression and professional development.

Our culture is not just a buzzword – It is social, informal, and open, with a flat organizational structure. We value diversity, social well-being, collaboration, and innovative thinking.

Ready to work on data-driven financial services?

Apply now to be part of a collaborative team where your skills are not just valued – It is celebrated!

If you find yourself aligned with this opportunity, then we would like to get to know you better.

Feel free to contact Claus Bruhn Bentzen, cbentzen@kpmg.com or Bjørn Larsen, bjolarsen@kpmg.com . We accept applications and interview candidates continuously and will close the position once we have found the right match.

At KPMG, we are committed to developing diverse talents at all levels. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Please note that we do not accept applications by e-mail to ensure GDPR compliance.

We look forward to welcoming you to KPMG.

Title: Assortment Analyst, IMEA
Description:
Are you passionate about retail, consumer behavior, and using data to drive commercial decisions? Do you thrive in a fast-paced international environment where creativity meets business performance?




Then you might be the Assortment Analyst we're looking for to help grow Flying Tiger Copenhagen across the IMEA (India, Middle East and Africa) region.




About the Role

Based at our HQ office in Central Copenhagen (Christianshavn), you will play a key role in optimizing the product assortment for our growing IMEA region.

Working closely with Commercial, Retail teams and franchise partners, you will use data and market insights to ensure our assortment reflects local customer needs while staying true to the Flying Tiger Copenhagen concept.

Your analysis and recommendations will directly support commercial performance, new store openings, and profitable growth across the region.




What you will do:




Drive assortment performance

Monitor product performance and identify opportunities to improve assortment relevance, sales, and profitability.
Analyze sales trends, customer behavior, and market insights to support assortment decisions.
Contribute to assortment reviews and recommend commercial actions based on data.




Support commercial planning

Support the planning of seasonal launches, campaigns, and commercial calendars.
Analyze product commitments and inventory plans to maximize commercial performance.
Partner with Demand Planning and Supply Chain to optimize product availability and inventory health.




Support business growth

Develop assortment and space recommendations for new store openings and existing stores.
Collaborate with stores and commercial teams to identify assortment gaps and growth opportunities.
Support continuous improvement of commercial processes and best practices.




Deliver insights

Prepare weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual business reporting.
Present recommendations to regional leadership and global stakeholders.
Conduct ad hoc analyses supporting strategic initiatives and business development.




Who you are

You have a bachelor’s degree in business, Economics, Engineering, Marketing, or a related field (master’s degree is a plus).
2-4 years of experience in retail planning, merchandising, category management, commercial planning, business analysis, or a similar analytical role.
Strong commercial mindset and passion for retail and customer behavior.
Excellent analytical skills with the ability to transform data into actionable insights.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Experience with BI and reporting tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, or similar) is an advantage.
Strong project management and organizational skills.
Effective communicator with the ability to collaborate across functions and cultures.
Fluent in English, both written and spoken.
Curious, proactive, and comfortable working in a dynamic, growing organization.




What We Offer

At Flying Tiger Copenhagen, we believe life is richer with fun. You'll join an international retail company where creativity, entrepreneurship, and collaboration are part of everyday life.

In this role, you'll have the opportunity to influence commercial decisions across a growing region, work closely with colleagues in Miami, Copenhagen, and Singapore, and help shape the future of Flying Tiger Copenhagen in IMEA.

You will report to the Head of Commercial, IMEA and become part of a regional team of eight entrepreneurial colleagues with close collaboration across our global organization.




Flying Tiger Copenhagen offers:




Probably the best location - in the heart of Copenhagen
Attractive pension plan
Private health insurance - also including children
Flexibility with the opportunity of working from home
Special discounts in our own Flying Tiger Shops
Fun and dynamic culture
A social and informal workplace with parties, Friday bars, staff club etc.
International work environment founded in Scandinavian culture
Delicious restaurant food in our own canteen everyday – including cake on Thursdays
Celebration and many other occasions to eat Cake
And much more…




Did you know?

We take climate change very seriously and work very hard to minimize our carbon footprint. We do this by buying less plastic and more renewable materials (everything which grows) – and we also want to make sure that all stores are run on renewable energy. We walk the talk – and make sure that what we do is validated by external experts, in the Science Based Targets initiative. You can read more about our work with climate action here.

Title: Group Business Controller & BI Analyst
Description:
Finance meets BI, automation and AI

Do you enjoy working with numbers and technology? Are you curious about how data, automation and AI can make Finance smarter and more effective?

LEMAN is looking for a Group Business Controller & BI Analyst who wants to combine hands-on business controlling with BI development and help shape the future of Finance.

This is a hybrid role with an approximately 50/50 focus on business controlling and BI. You'll work with budgets, forecasts and performance analysis while also building Power BI solutions, improving reporting processes and exploring new ways to use automation and AI.

In other words: you don't just analyse the numbers. You help improve how we work with them.

The role

You'll join our Finance organisation and report to the Head of Controlling. You'll work closely with colleaguesreit in Finance, IT and across the business, giving you a broad network and plenty of opportunity to influence how we use data and technology.

As part of the role, you'll be responsible for controlling activities related to LEMAN Logistics, covering our warehousing operations in Denmark, Norway, the UK and the US. You'll work closely with local logistics directors and lead the monthly performance follow-up.

You'll also support Group back-office functions such as People & Culture, IT and Commercial with financial analysis, reporting and decision support.

Your Main Responsibilities


Prepare and follow up on budgets, forecasts and financial performance
Analyse results, identify deviations and turn data into clear business insights
Lead monthly performance reviews with local logistics directors
Support Group functions with financial analysis and decision-making
Build and develop reports and dashboards in Power BI
Take ownership of the continued development of BI solutions within Finance
Identify opportunities to improve financial analysis, reporting and processes through automation and AI
Act as the link between Finance, IT and the wider business


Who are you?

You have a solid foundation in controlling or finance analytics, but you're also genuinely interested in data, technology and how things can be done better.

You don't need to be an IT specialist. What matters is that you understand Finance, enjoy working with data and are comfortable getting hands-on with technology.

We Imagine That You


Have a relevant degree, such as cand.merc., HD or equivalent
Have around 3–5 years of relevant experience in controlling, finance analytics or BI
Have practical experience with Power BI and SQL
Have an interest in automation, AI and new technology
Understand budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis and management reporting
Can turn business needs into practical reporting and BI solutions
Communicate confidently with financial, technical and operational stakeholders
Are curious, proactive and comfortable building relationships across the organisation
Enjoy taking ownership and driving things forward
Speak and write Danish fluently and have strong English skills


You don't have to tick every box. If you have a strong Finance background and a real interest in BI, technology and improving the way things work, we'd like to hear from you.

A role with room to make a difference

This isn't a role where you simply maintain existing reports and follow established processes.

You'll have the opportunity to shape how Finance works with data, BI, automation and AI and to see your ideas turn into solutions that are used across the organisation.

You'll be part of an experienced Finance team where you can exchange ideas, learn from colleagues and challenge existing ways of working. At the same time, your role will be highly visible across the organisation, giving you the opportunity to build a broad network and make a real impact.

Why LEMAN?

LEMAN is a global logistics company with an ambition to continuously improve how we use data and technology to make better business decisions.

We believe that good work should leave room for life outside work. That's why we offer:


Flexible working from home by agreement
11% employer-paid pension contribution + 2% employee contribution
Company-paid internet and mobile phone
Canteen and lunch scheme
Insurance coverage
Employee association with regular social activities
Fitness facilities and massage treatment
The opportunity to take 1–2 months of fully paid sabbatical leave
Enjoy a benefits package designed with you in mind: 25 days of annual leave, five additional paid leave days, bank holidays, comprehensive medical coverage, pension and delicious meals. We can’t wait to tell you more in person!
Flexibility: We understand that life is unpredictable, which is why we offer flexible working arrangements, where possible, to help you achieve a healthy work-life balance. You'll have the freedom to structure your workday in a way that suits you best – whether that means working from home, adjusting your hours, or taking time off when you need it.
Sabbatical: Need a break from the daily grind? We offer sabbatical opportunities to take extended time off to recharge, explore your passions, and come back to work feeling refreshed and inspired.
Investment in Professional Development: We're committed to helping our people grow and reach their full potential.
Global Travel Opportunities: We're a global organisation with offices around the world, which means that there are plenty of opportunities to travel and experience new cultures.
Social and Company Events: We believe that work should be enjoyable, which is why we organise regular social and company events to bring our people together.


About Us

LEMAN is a global company with deep roots and a modern, people-centric approach. We believe in empowering our colleagues and creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and inspired to perform at their best.

Every day, we provide customised logistics and transport solutions that make a difference for companies and people around the world. We’re large enough to deliver top-quality global supply chain solutions yet small enough to offer truly personal experience – for both our customers and each other.

Title: Digital Innovation&Transformation Sup
Description:
Manufacturing Intelligence & Data Supporter

DPM KA Business Support | Temporary Position (12 Months)

Location: Kalundborg

Department: Drug Product Manufacturing KA, Business Support

Do you want to be the link between data and decision-making?

Are you motivated by turning data into solutions that create real value in manufacturing? Do you thrive at the intersection of technology, business, and people? If so, you may be the Manufacturing Intelligence & Data Supporter we are looking for.

In this role, you will be a key partner to both manufacturing and the business. You will not only work with data, visualization, and digital solutions, but also understand user needs and translate them into solutions that support better decision-making and increased productivity. A significant part of the role is therefore being close to the business and understanding how data can support daily operations and long-term decision-making.

You will play a central role as the link between operations, data, and decision-makers.

The Position Consists Of Two Main Areas Of Responsibility

Data Engineering and Productivity Improvements

Your Responsibilities Will Include


Identifying and understanding business needs for data.
Preparing, structuring, and modelling data for analysis and visualization.
Developing and maintaining dashboards and visualization solutions.
Supporting productivity improvements through digital solutions.
Contributing to the development of software solutions such as Power BI, RPA, web applications, or similar tools.
Collaborating closely with users and stakeholders to ensure solutions create value.


Local Data Support

You Will


Ensure visibility and understanding of data and data flows across DPM KA.
Develop and maintain data flows from primary data sources such as PLC systems and SQL servers to Novo Nordisk’s Enterprise Data Lake.
Support high data quality and availability.
Contribute to the development of future solutions within Databricks and AI-based data platforms.
Ensure robust and scalable data solutions for the organization.


Who are you?

We welcome candidates with diverse backgrounds and levels of experience.

Experience from a manufacturing environment is an advantage, but not essential. Most importantly, you are curious, business-oriented, and motivated by understanding users’ challenges and translating them into value-creating solutions.

You hold a relevant educational background within areas such as Data Science, Computer Science, Software Development, Automation, Digitalisation, Engineering, IT, or a related field.

We are open to both Bachelor's and Master's degree holders.

We imagine that you have experience in several of the following areas:


Data visualization using Power BI, Grafana, or similar tools.
Data modelling and data preparation.
Programming in C#, SQL, Python, or similar technologies.
Development of data flows and data integrations.
Statistical analysis and data processing.
Dashboard development and reporting.
Modern data platforms and cloud-based solutions.


Experience with Databricks, AWS, Alteryx, or similar technologies is an advantage but not a requirement.

As a Person, You Are


Analytical and structured.
Business-oriented.
Collaborative.
Results-driven.
Comfortable working on complex data projects.
Curious about users’ needs.
Skilled at building relationships across the organization.


You enjoy dialogue and collaboration and are not afraid to engage directly with processes and the people who use the solutions you help develop.

Why should you apply?

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Transform complex operational data into decision-making insights.
Work at the intersection of technology and business.
Gain broad exposure across the organization.
Deliver tangible improvements through data and digitalization.
Collaborate with a wide range of stakeholders.
Contribute to the digital transformation of Drug Product Manufacturing.


In other words, you will have the opportunity to serve as the link between the data we collect and the decisions that drive the business forward.

About The Department

You will become part of Business Support in Drug Product Manufacturing Kalundborg.

DPM KA consists of approximately 570 employees responsible for transforming active pharmaceutical ingredients into finished medicines for patients around the world. The production area includes environmental monitoring, washing and sterilization, formulation, aseptic filling, freeze-drying, and visual inspection.

Business Support functions as a cross-functional support organization across the department. The team collaborates with many different stakeholders and supports operations, digitalization, and continuous improvement initiatives. This gives you a broad range of interfaces and the opportunity to work across a variety of processes and professional disciplines.

Practical Information

Start date: As soon as possible, and no later than November 1

Duration: 12 months, with the possibility of extension

Employment is subject to a background check and criminal record certificate

Salary: For this position, the annual base salary ranges between DKK 499,600 and DKK 734,400, depending on the position level. Placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Bonus and employee benefits: The compensation package may include short-term and/or long-term incentive schemes as well as additional employee benefits, depending on job level, geographical location, professional area, and relevant market benchmarks.

For further information, please contact Sr. Manager Kenneth Normand at +45 34480982 or knod@novonordisk.com

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
About Scrumconnect Consulting

Scrumconnect Consulting is a multi-award-winning digital consultancy, recognised for delivering impactful and innovative technology solutions across UK government departments. Our work has positively influenced the lives of over 40 million UK citizens.

We are passionate about user-centred design, agile delivery, and building digital services that make a real difference. Our teams work at the forefront of innovation, helping organisations transform and deliver high-quality, scalable solutions that truly matter.




Overview :




The Data Analyst will be responsible for analysing data, developing insightful dashboards, and providing data-driven insights to support informed decision-making.




Key Responsibilities & Skills

Report Design & Delivery

Advanced experience translating stakeholder requirements into intuitive, accessible dashboards and reports that enable self-service data exploration.
Strong experience with Microsoft Power BI, DAX and Excel to develop data models and create efficient, optimised and scalable reports and visualisations.
Ability to design dashboards that clearly communicate complex data and insights to a range of stakeholders.

Data Analysis & Synthesis

Strong experience integrating multiple data sources into a conformed data model for analysis.
Proficiency in SQL, Python, Power Query and M.
Experience in data cleansing, transformation and preparation for reporting and analysis.

Statistical Analysis & Techniques

Proven experience applying a broad range of statistical techniques to support data-driven decision-making.
Strong understanding of averages, standard deviation, correlation, regression and statistical significance testing.
Ability to interpret statistical results and communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Technical Understanding of Dash boarding Products

Experience monitoring emerging technologies and assessing their potential application to dashboard and data visualisation products.
Ability to provide recommendations on tools and technologies that can improve reporting and data visualisation capabilities.

Key Skills: Power BI | DAX | Excel | SQL | Python | Power Query | M | Data Modelling | Data Visualisation | Statistical Analysis










Diversity & Inclusion

At Scrumconnect Consulting, we believe that diversity drives innovation and better outcomes. We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every individual is valued, respected, and supported.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and actively encourage individuals from under-represented groups, including women, people with disabilities, and diverse communities, as well as those seeking flexible working arrangements.

As a Disability Confident Level 1 employer, we are committed to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process and during employment to ensure equal opportunities for all.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
VOY is a fast growing Healthtech scale-up, aiming to be the healthcare provider that millions of people trust as their partner to a long and healthy life. Our platform allows users to quickly and safely diagnose possible conditions, get treatment and support them afterwards to live a higher quality life. To do this we are building an all in one healthcare platform which brings together world leading medical expertise and technical excellence.

We are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our growing Data team and help drive smarter, data-informed decisions across the organisation.

The Opportunity

This is a high-impact role where the insights you surface and the dashboards you build directly influence how our teams operate and how well we support our patients.

Who you are


You have strong SQL skills and can write queries confidently to extract, transform and analyse data
You're comfortable with data visualisation tools and understand how to design dashboards that are intuitive and actionable
You think carefully about data -what metrics mean, what the data is actually telling you, and how to communicate it clearly
You're curious and self-driven, comfortable exploring datasets to uncover insights and answer difficult questions
You're a natural communicator who can translate analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations
You collaborate well with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and take ownership end-to-end
You're excited about working in a fast-paced environment and motivated by the idea that your work helps improve patient outcomes at scale


What you will do

Translate data into insight


Conduct ad-hoc analyses to answer business questions from stakeholders across Operations, Finance, Clinical and Programme teams
Identify trends, patterns and anomalies in operational and clinical data that impact service delivery and patient outcomes
Present findings in clear, compelling ways that drive decision-making across the organisation


Build and maintain dashboards & reports


Design and build dashboards in Looker that track key metrics across the business - from programme delivery KPIs to financial performance
Develop automated reports that keep stakeholders informed without requiring manual updates
Ensure dashboards are accurate, performant and easy to navigate for end users


Contribute to data quality & modelling


Write clear, optimised SQL to query and manipulate data reliably
Collaborate with the Data Engineering team on data modelling, dbt transformations and data governance
Identify and escalate data quality issues and help ensure consistency across systems
Help define and track metrics that matter, ensuring every KPI is well understood and correctly calculated


Partner across teams


Work closely with stakeholders across Operations, Clinical, Finance and Programme Delivery to understand their data needs
Communicate complex data concepts in a way that's accessible to non-technical stakeholders
Help drive adoption of data-driven thinking and self-serve analytics across the organisation


What we need from you


2-4 years of experience in a data analyst, business analyst or similar analytics role
Proficiency in SQL - you can write queries to explore, filter, join and aggregate data reliably
Experience with at least one BI/visualisation tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar)
Familiarity with modern data stacks and tools (BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL, dbt are all helpful)
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an eye for detail
Excellent communication skills - able to explain complex findings clearly to diverse audiences
This is a hybrid role requiring 3 days per week in the office


Experience you may have


A degree in a quantitative subject (Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, etc.)
Experience in healthcare, public health or regulated industries
Exposure to Python or R for data analysis and statistical work
Experience working in fast-growing, high-impact environments
Familiarity with dbt or other data transformation frameworks


Please note that this is a hybrid role with a requirement of in office presence, 3 days per week

Healthcare is broken. We’re fixing it — and we need your help.

Back in 2019, we launched MANUAL to tackle men's health (starting with hair loss and sexual health). A few years later, we launched Voy with a focus on weight loss. But our ambition has always been bigger. Healthcare too often treats conditions in isolation, not people as a whole, and we're on a mission to prove there's a better way.

In 2025, we evolved from MANUAL into Voy, a brand built for the long game: supporting people through every stage of life, not just a single diagnosis. Today, we support over 1 million members across the UK, Germany and Brazil, delivering personalised care across weight loss, menopause, hair loss and TRT (with more categories on the way).

Ready to join us and change how healthcare feels for millions of people?

Description:
Performance Data Analyst (SEND)

Job Summary:

Are you passionate about using data to improve outcomes for children and young people with Special Educational Needs and Disabilities (SEND)? Do you thrive in a high-impact analytical role where your work directly informs strategic decision-making and service transformation?

This is an exciting opportunity to help transform SEND services through data and intelligence. You will work closely with senior leaders and partners to improve outcomes for children and young people across Ealing.

Ealing Council have an exciting new opportunity as Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) available on a full time. We are seeking a skilled and motivated Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) to join our Schools Data, Performance and Intelligence team. The post holder will play a key role in supporting SEND services by delivering high-quality insight and ensuring statutory reporting is accurate and timely, including SEN2.

In this role you will also contribute to shaping data systems, supporting SEND reforms, and enabling senior leaders to make informed decisions that improve outcomes for residents.

We strive to create communities where everyone can live a long, happy, and healthy life, full of pride and identity. We aim to create an environment where every child can reach their potential and achieve their dreams.

The Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) role:


Lead statutory returns (including SEN2) ensuring compliance and deadlines are met
Develop and enhance data systems and reporting frameworks
Analyze complex datasets to identify trends and inform planning
Produce high-quality dashboards and reports (e.g. Power BI)
Provide expert advice on data interpretation and performance
Support forecasting including specialist school place planning
Collaborate with services, ICT and partners to improve data systems
Ensure strong data quality, validation and GDPR compliance


Our ideal Performance and Data Analyst (SEND) will have the below skills and experience:


Advanced skills in Excel, SQL and Power BI
Strong analytical and forecasting capability
Experience working with large datasets
Excellent communication and presentation skills
Ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines
Experience in SEND, education or public sector


We are not accepting CVs, you must complete a supporting statement providing examples of how you meet each of the criteria in the job description section of the role profile. Any applications received with a CV will not be progressed or reviewed.

Equality and Inclusion:

You must have the right to work in the UK. Evidence for the right to work in the UK will be requested at the interview stage.

It is an exciting time to join us, here at Ealing Council. If you would like to make a positive difference to our residents and borough, then we’re looking forward to hearing from you.

Ealing council is committed to safeguarding children and vulnerable adults and expects all staff to share this commitment. Ealing follows safer recruitment practices to protect children and vulnerable adults.

Please note all applications will be determined on merit.

From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

The company presents this job description as a guide to the major areas and duties for which the jobholder is accountable. However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Must hold a valid Security Clearance




As a Senior Data Analyst at Made Tech, you’ll play a pivotal role in helping public sector organisations become truly data-led. You’ll join our data team in its mission to get data knowledge and skills out of silos and embedded into delivery teams. You will provide advanced data modelling, predictive analytics, and data visualisation, allowing us to deliver more sophisticated and customised solutions to our clients.




The role is very hands-on and you'll support as a senior contributor role for a project, focusing on:

Data analysis and reporting: Conducting in-depth data analysis, generating reports, and providing actionable insights for client projects.
Data and BI visualisation: Producing BI dashboards using industry-standard tools - Power BI, Tableau, Quicksight etc
Client interaction: Collaborating with clients to understand their needs, translating these into analytical solutions, and presenting findings in a clear, actionable manner.
Mentoring junior analysts, leading data-focused projects, and setting best practices in data analysis

Key responsibilities

Analysis and synthesis

Application of analytical techniques: Proficiency in applying various analytical methods such as statistical analysis, data mining, and qualitative analysis. Ability to select and apply appropriate techniques based on the context and research data.
Synthesis of research data: Experience in synthesising research data to present actionable insights and solutions. Ability to articulate the impact of their analysis on decision-making and problem-solving.
Engagement with sceptical colleagues: Effective communication and persuasion skills to engage and gain buy-in from sceptical colleagues. Ability to foster collaboration and address concerns to ensure adherence to best practices.
Advisory and critique skills: Capability to advise on the choice and application of analytical techniques and critique colleagues' findings to ensure high standards in data analysis.

Data Management

Understanding of data sources and storage: Knowledge of various data sources, data organisation, and storage practices. Commitment to maintaining data integrity and accessibility.
Advocacy for data governance: Experience in advocating for data governance standards and influencing team adherence to data quality practices.
Continuous improvement: Ability to communicate and implement continuous improvements in data management practices through documentation, training, and regular team engagement.
Toolset management: Proficiency in defining and supporting common toolsets for data management, ensuring efficiency and seamless integration.
Automation of data management: Experience in automating data management activities to streamline processes and increase accuracy. (desirable)
Compliance with data governance policies: Understanding and ensuring compliance with data governance policies, maintaining data security and ethical standards.

Data modelling, cleansing, and enrichment

Data modelling expertise: Proficient in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling. Ability to adhere to data modelling standards and best practices.
Data cleansing and standardisation: Experience in resolving data quality issues and ensuring data accuracy through cleansing and standardisation techniques.
Use of data integration tools: Skilled in using ETL tools for data integration and storage. Ensures data interoperability with other datasets.
Collaboration with data professionals: Experience collaborating with other data professionals to improve modelling and integration standards and patterns.

Data Visualisation

Interpretation of requirements: Ability to interpret data visualisation requirements and create meaningful, visually appealing representations tailored to the audience.
Proficiency in visualisation tools: Experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, and Python libraries like Matplotlib and Seaborn. Knowledge of selecting appropriate visualisation types.
Application of visualisation standards: Application of design principles to create clear, accurate, and accessible visualisations. Awareness of accessibility considerations.
Mentorship in visualisation: Experience in reviewing and advising junior members to improve the quality and efficiency of data visualisations.

Data Quality Assurance, Validation, and Linkage

Data quality assurance: Experience in implementing processes for data quality assessment and improvement, including data profiling, cleansing, and standardisation.
Data validation and linkage: Ability to perform data validation checks and integrate data from various sources to ensure consistency and accuracy.
Data cleansing and preparation: Proficiency in defining data cleansing processes and preparing data for analysis by handling missing values, outliers, and duplicates.
Communication of data limitations: Skilled in articulating data constraints and limitations to stakeholders, providing context for informed decision-making.
Peer review and quality control: Experience in conducting peer reviews to validate data outputs, ensuring high standards of accuracy and reliability.

Statistical Methods and Data Analysis

Knowledge of statistical methodologies: Proficient in various statistical methods, such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, clustering, and time series analysis. Ability to select appropriate techniques based on project requirements.
Data analysis and interpretation: Experience in using statistical software or programming languages to perform data analysis and generate insights. Skilled in communicating findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Application of emerging theory: Willingness to explore and apply new statistical methodologies or practices to solve practical problems and adapt to emerging theories.

Skills, knowledge and expertise

Communication

Stakeholder communication: Experience in effectively engaging with a diverse range of stakeholders, including technical and business individuals. Ability to manage expectations and facilitate productive discussions.
Active and reactive communication: Proficiency in handling both proactive communication (updates, insights) and reactive communication (responding to inquiries, addressing concerns) to maintain a collaborative atmosphere.
Interpretation of stakeholder needs: Ability to understand and translate stakeholder requirements into technical solutions. Experience in bridging the gap between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Presentation and sharing of insights: Skilled in presenting complex data in a clear, understandable manner tailored to diverse audiences, including senior management.

Logical and creative thinking

Description:
Music is Universal

It’s the passionate and dedicated team at Universal Music who help make us the world’s leading music company. From A&R to finance, legal to digital, sales to marketing, Universal Music is the place to grow and develop your career within a truly commercial and innovative business that leads in everything it does.

Everyone is welcome to apply for our roles, and we are determined to ensure that no applicant or employee receives less favourable treatment because of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion, belief, age, marital status, background, pregnancy, or caring responsibilities. We also recognise the importance of diversity of thought within our teams and are fully committed to embracing the talents of people with autism, dyslexia, ADHD, and other forms of neurocognitive variation.

We will always seek to make appropriate adjustments to recruitment, workplaces, and work processes to be fully inclusive to people with different needs and working styles. If you need us to make any reasonable adjustments for you from application onwards, including alternatives to the online form or to disclose a neurocognitive condition, please email UniversalMusicCareers@umusic.com.

Are you interested in working for the music industry? Would you like to help turn data into insight that drives innovation and creative data-driven strategies across Universal Music?

Universal Music UK is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to become part of our UK central data, AI and technology team. The role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the start of a new chapter, where we are looking to grow & expand on the foundation of work we’ve already begun.

The role is perfect for a candidate that is passionate about music, data, AI and technology and has a thirst for acquiring, analysing and communicating knowledge through data. In a creative organisation such as ours, reducing a complex problem into something simple is key, so any experience managing stakeholders, shaping questions and translating data into clear insight would also be a strength.

Alongside this, you will be responsible for delivering analysis, reporting and measurement that helps solve real business problems across Universal Music UK. You will work with stakeholders to understand business needs, define the right questions and turn complex data into clear, actionable insight. Working closely with data scientists, engineers, product managers and business teams, you will help improve how we measure performance, understand audiences and identify opportunities for our artists, labels and central teams. As we’re first and foremost a data, AI and technology team, you should be comfortable working with large datasets, technical teams and modern analytics tools.

As part of the central data, AI and technology team, you’ll have a chance to work across all divisions, including AMS, frontline labels, our catalogue division UMR, and all other central teams, as well as data and technology teams within the wider business. This includes helping shape insight, reporting and data products that support & supercharge the labels.

Key Responsibilities

Core responsibilities include:


Working directly with the Data & AI team to support artists & labels across the business.
Being a senior voice within the team and leading data strategy at a label level.
Supporting core strategic research with data & audience insight.
Researching & developing data driven solutions to solve current & future business problems.
Utilising partner data to pull out key metrics and feeding back to the label teams.
Advising on data related topics to help guide or inform business decisions.
Sourcing, cleaning and preparing data for modelling, product creation or visualisation.
Developing new data sets or features that become integral to how the business operates.


At the heart of this role is a desire to give us a competitive edge in connecting our artists with audiences across the globe. More will be explained at Interview. Rest assured, this is an exciting role as part of an innovative new initiative within the organisation.

Skills

Skills & Experience


Strong ability to translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight.
Creative and commercially minded approach to problem-solving.
Strong stakeholder engagement, management and communication skills.
Ability to lead analytical projects from idea through to delivery and adoption.
Advanced SQL skills with experience querying large datasets accurately and efficiently.
Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform or AWS.
Experience building dashboards, reporting products and self-serve insight tools.
Strong understanding of data modelling, ETL/ELT processes and data quality.
Working knowledge of Python or another programming language for analysis.
Familiarity with Git, version control and modern analytics workflows.
Good understanding of AI, machine learning concepts and their practical application.
Ability to mentor others and raise the quality of analytical work across a team.
Knowledge of music repertoire is advantageous.


Experience


Minimum of 4 years’ experience in a data analyst, analytics or related role.
Background engaging stakeholders in a consultative or analytical capacity.
Experience leading analysis that informs business decisions and product development.
Experience working with engineering, data science or product teams to turn analysis into scalable tools, reporting or data products.


Education


Degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
A background in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Economics, Data Science or a similarly analytical discipline would be advantageous.


Just So You Know…

However, the business operates in an environment that demands change and the jobholder's specific responsibilities and activities will vary and develop. Therefore, the job description should be seen as indicative and not as a permanent, definitive, and exhaustive statement.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Strategic Finance
Description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM


~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation


The Opportunity

Relay's network is scaling fast. The decisions that shape that growth, where to expand, how to price, where to invest, are made by a finance team that runs on data: driver-level metrics, profitability models, pricing structures, and operational KPIs. This role exists to own the analytics layer that powers those decisions.

As a Senior Data Analyst in the finance squad, you are responsible for how finance sees the business. You own the dashboards and reporting that give visibility into the metrics that matter: cost per parcel, expansion profitability, client and cohort performance, pricing dynamics, and the drivers underneath them. You translate raw operational data into views that finance can use to forecast, model, and act.

Relay operates a centralised data team of around 30 data engineers, analysts, and data scientists, with analysts embedded into squads across the business. You will sit in the finance squad, but report into the centralised data team. You will work closely with the Senior Data Scientist in the squad, building the reporting and visibility layer on top of their simulation models. You will also work across squads, pulling the metrics they commit to the semantic layer and shaping them into the views finance needs.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?


You take ownership of your domain. You don't wait to be told what finance needs or when something is broken. You're proactive about understanding the questions they're trying to answer and making sure the data is there to answer them.
You're an excellent data analyst who builds clean, reliable reporting that people actually use. You care about data quality, clarity, and making complex metrics understandable.
You're fluent in SQL and experienced with dbt. You can build and maintain well-structured models, not just write queries.
You're comfortable with BI tools and visualisation platforms. You know how to design dashboards that surface the right information without clutter.
You have at least 5 years of experience, ideally with some exposure to finance, FP&A, or commercial analytics. You understand how finance teams think about metrics and drivers.
You communicate clearly with non-technical partners. Finance will rely on your reporting to make decisions. You need to explain what it shows, where the data comes from, and where the limitations are.
You're comfortable working across teams. You'll pull metrics from squads across the business, which means building relationships and understanding how different parts of Relay operate.


Fast and Focused Hiring Process


Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 min
Technical SQL Interview - 1 hours
Hiring Manager Interview - 45 min
Case Study - 1 hour
Values & Impact Interview - 45 min
Decision and offer within 48 hours. Our process mirrors our pace of work.


Compensation, Benefits & Workplace


Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).


Who Thrives at Relay?


Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.


If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
A brief summary




Based within our global Media Services function, this role sits in the Assets & Data team and reports to the Head of Assets & Data. The Data Analyst helps the business make better use of its data, with a particular focus on S&OP, asset management and resource planning across the Group.




Using SQL, Power BI and Excel, the role will turn data from our Group systems into useful reporting and insight. A key part of the role is helping people understand what the data is telling us how our assets are being used, where demand is changing and where there may be opportunities to improve utilisation, reduce cost or make better investment decisions.




What you’ll be responsible for

Write and maintain SQL queries to bring together and prepare data from Group business systems for analysis and reporting.
Build and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports that help the business understand asset utilisation, demand, availability and performance.
Analyse asset, resource and demand planning data to spot trends, capacity issues, under utilisation and opportunities to improve efficiency or reduce cost.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and teams across the business to understand the questions they are trying to answer and turn these into useful analysis and reporting.
Check and reconcile data before it is used in reporting, investigate anything that does not look right and work with the relevant data owners to resolve issues.
Support good data governance by helping to keep definitions, standards and quality checks consistent across asset and master data.
Keep clear, practical documentation for key reports, dashboards, calculations and recurring analysis so that others can understand how they work and pick them up when needed.
Work with IT where reporting depends on changes to systems, data access or integrations. The role will help define what the business needs from its data, with IT retaining responsibility for system architecture, security, access controls and technical infrastructure.
Work with the Head of Assets & Data and business teams to improve the information held in operational systems, including highlighting gaps, inconsistencies or unclear data ownership.
Provide regular and ad hoc analysis to support S&OP, asset planning, investment decisions, business cases and improvement activity across the Group.
Look for sensible ways to make reporting and analysis quicker and easier, including automation and appropriate use of AI tools, while making sure outputs are checked and company data is handled appropriately.

Requirements

Relevant degree, professional qualification or equivalent practical experience, together with at least two years' experience in a data analyst, BI analyst or similar role.
Strong working knowledge of SQL and confidence using it to query, combine and manipulate data.
Experience building and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with a good understanding of data modelling, measures and how to present information clearly.
Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, formulas and working with larger datasets.
Experience of cleaning and checking data, including dealing with duplicates, missing information and inconsistencies.

Job Description

This is a highly visible role, working closely with traders and quantitative research specialists to deliver scalable data solutions and actionable insights.



You will be part of a collaborative global team, supporting a wide range of market-facing activities while helping to improve data infrastructure, performance, and innovation across the platform.



What you’ll be doing:



Partnering with traders and global markets teams to understand data needs and delivering practical solutions
Building and maintaining scalable data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools
Supporting quantitative research initiatives, including developing and applying analytical models
Identifying gaps in data infrastructure and driving improvements for reliability and scalability

Collaborating with global stakeholders to support workflows across multiple regions

Translating complex technical outputs into clear insights for non-technical audiences

Strong Python experience including Pandas, NumPy or similar data analysis libraries

Experience building data pipelines, working with cloud platforms, and integrating APIs

Strong communication skills with the ability to engage and collaborate with non-technical stakeholders
Proven problem-solving ability and experience working in a fast-paced environment

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M), led by deep-tech investors Plural (whose portfolio spans fusion energy and space exploration), Relay is scaling faster than 99.98% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.




THE TEAM

• ~110 people, more than half in engineering, product and data

• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research

• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle

• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation




The Opportunity

Relay’s Last Mile network runs on couriers - tens of thousands of them, doing real work in the physical world every day. Whether each parcel gets delivered successfully depends on the decisions and behaviours of the courier on route. We're hiring for a Senior Data Analyst to own how Relay measures and improves courier excellence: how we shape what happens on the doorstep, and how we manage performance before and after that interaction.

This role works with the whole of the Last Mile team and partners closely with data scientists, engineers and operators across the squad. There's a v1 of performance management already running; you'll own its evolution into something materially better.




Last Mile

Handover Optimisation: Every handover is a trade-off between competing outcomes - speed, quality, and risk. Moving any one of them can have knock-on effects on the others, and finding the right balance is one of the most interesting analytical problems in the network. Your job is to make those trade-offs visible, model them, and find the levers that move the network in the right direction. You'll run the experiments, design the measurement, and quantify what actually works.

Performance Management: Relay already has a framework for measuring courier performance, and it feeds into how work is distributed. The job now is to ensure it drives fleet quality - defining the right behaviours to measure, evaluating the interventions designed to help couriers shift those behaviours, and closing the loop so the framework continuously improves. You'll partner with product, ops and engineering across this work, with the analytics owned by you.

Courier-facing analytics: Couriers are the end users of much of this work. You'll think about how performance and rewards are made transparent to them, and you'll run experiments to evaluate whether interventions are actually working for couriers and for Relay.




Who Will Thrive in This Role

You're a strong analyst who thinks in systems. You break complex problems into components and know where the real opportunity lies.
You are successful working with high autonomy and are excited to operate in a Product/Programme Manager like capacity, defining the roadmap as well as executing against it.
You care about solving the problem more than which techniques you use.
You love working with smart, motivated people.
You're fluent in SQL.
You're comfortable across the analytical spectrum - designing and reading experiments, building risk scores and segmentation, and shipping descriptive analysis that drives a decision the same week.
You communicate inclusively with non-technical team members.
You love seeing the impact of your work play out in a daily operation.
Bonus: You have experience working on performance management, marketplace quality, operational analytics or another relevant domain.




Compensation, Benefits & Workplace

Generous equity, richer than 99% of European startups, with annual top-ups to share Relay’s success.
Private health & dental coverage, so comprehensive you’d need to be a partner at a Magic Circle law firm to match it.
25 days of holidays
Enhanced parental leave.
Located in Shoreditch, our office set-up enables the kind of in-person interactions that drive impact. We work 4 days on-site, with 1 day remote.
Hardware of your choice.
Extensive perks (gym subsidies, cycle-to-work, Friday office lunch, covered Uber home and dinner for late nights, and more).




Who Thrives at Relay?

Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.
Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.
1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.
All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.
People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.
Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

At Wickes, we’re on a mission to create simple, digital-first experiences that help our customers build, repair, and improve their homes. Behind every great project is great data. As our new Senior Data Analyst, you’ll be at the heart of our data-driven decision-making, supporting various departments with advanced analytics, decision support, MI scoping, and hands-on training.




This role is based in Watford with occasional travel to Northampton.




What you’ll be doing:

Deep Dive Analysis: Deliver detailed, relevant insights that empower business areas to make smart, impactful decisions.
Data Lake Development: Collaborate with key stakeholders and fellow analysts to shape the development of our Data Lake, recommending and implementing robust analytical solutions.
Reporting & Governance: Own data tables management, manage business rules and logic, and ensure top-tier data quality assurance, accuracy, and confidentiality across all systems.
Empowering the Business: Support company reporting needs, maintain robust processes for team best practice, and champion super-user "spokes" across the business to foster self-sufficiency.
Documentation & Training: Create user manuals, documentation, and training materials that translate complex IT and data concepts into clear, accessible guidance for non-technical colleagues.




What we’re looking for:

Relevant professional or industry training, including advanced SQL and Data Analysis.
5+ years of BI and data experience, with a strong background in business partnering.




Skills & Technical Knowledge

Expert proficiency with BI tools and cloud data warehouse technologies (e.g., BigQuery), with confidence handling large datasets.
Strong understanding of SQL databases, star and snowflake schema modelling, and building both basic and complex queries.
Functional and technical competence in Google reporting and data warehouse architecture.
Exceptional communication skills, capable of explaining complex data simply, managing projects end-to-end, and providing first-line user support and triage.
Collaborative team player who is energetic, proactive, well-organised, and responsive to competing priorities.




What can we offer you?

You’ll be supported with fantastic learning and development and have the opportunity to grow and develop your career with us. We also have an early careers network to support you if you’re in your first few years of your career.




We’ll also equip you with a benefits package that includes:

Competitive bonus
Save-as-you-earn scheme
Private Medical and Life Assurance
Enhanced contributory pension scheme
Colleague discount




Discount platform including savings and cash back at numerous retailers, savings on gym membership, cycle to work scheme

Our widely recognised wellbeing strategy is something we’re proud of at Wickes. As part of this, we offer a range of health and wellbeing benefits and support, including an Employee Assistance Programme, financial education & loans, and access to parental, menopause and fertility support.

By giving you the support you need to do well at work, and the flexibility to make life work for you. We are giving you a career that doesn’t put your life on hold. Where you can be yourself, do your best work, and make a positive difference every day.

Wickes is a multi-channel retailer operating in the home improvement market. With 50 years in industry, Wickes now generates revenue in excess of £1.6bn across 230 stores delivered by 8,000+ colleagues. But it is our culture that is considered our best kept secret; it’s a collaborative, down to earth, fun and inclusive environment where people feel part of a winning team. All our colleagues come from different backgrounds, but what we all have in common is a determination to succeed and a passion for being the best we can be. If that sounds like you, we’ll make you feel right at home.




We aim to create an inclusive workplace with colleagues’ wellbeing at the heart of everything we do.




We’re a Disability Confident Employer and committed to building a diverse workforce that reflects the communities we serve. Title: Data Analyst
Description:
About Moon Commerce

Moon Commerce Limited is a UK-registered technology company building and operating digital ventures across commerce, consulting, property and SaaS. We trade online, advise businesses on digital transformation and data-driven marketing, and are developing an AI-powered automation platform that turns repetitive processes into scalable systems.

We're small and early-stage, which means the person in this role will see the whole business rather than one corner of it.

The role

Our data currently lives in separate places — sales platforms, ad accounts, client reporting, and internal systems. You'll bring it together and turn it into reporting the team actually uses to make decisions.

This is a hands-on role with direct mentoring from the leadership team. You won't be maintaining someone else's dashboards; you'll be building the reporting layer from the ground up.

What you'll do

Build and maintain dashboards covering trading performance, marketing spend and client delivery
Extract, clean and join data from multiple sources
Turn business questions into analysis, and analysis into recommendations people can act on
Own weekly and monthly reporting across our ventures
Support pricing, inventory and campaign decisions with evidence
Document your work so it survives you

Your first three months

Month 1: learn the ventures, map where every data source lives, fix the reporting that's most broken
Month 2: ship your first dashboard into weekly use
Month 3: Own the monthly reporting pack end to end

What we're looking for

Minimum 2 years' hands-on SQL experience
Python (pandas) or strong Excel, plus Power BI, Tableau or Looker Studio
At least one project you can walk us through end to end and defend the decisions in
Clear written and spoken English; you'll present to non-technical people
Attention to detail and a habit of checking your own numbers
Right to work in the UK — we cannot offer sponsorship
Able to work from our [area] office 2 days a week

Nice to have

eCommerce, marketplace or digital marketing data experience
GA4, Shopify, Amazon Seller Central or similar
Any exposure to Git

What we offer

Salary £35,000–£39,000 depending on experience
25 days' annual leave plus 8 UK bank holidays
Office closed between Christmas and New Year
Workplace pension with [15 ]% employer contributions]
Hybrid working — 2 days a week at our [area] office, 37.5 hours, permanent
£[3750] annual learning budget for courses and certifications
Direct mentoring from the leadership team and exposure across every venture
Real ownership of your work and a short path to broader responsibility

Hiring process

20-minute introductory call
45-minute technical conversation including a short SQL exercise
30-minute conversation with the founding team

We aim to give a decision within a week of the final stage, and we give feedback either way.

Reporting to: Technology Lead

Visa sponsorship: We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role. Applicants must already hold the right to work in the UK.

Equal opportunities

Moon Commerce is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions on merit. If you need any adjustment to the application or interview process, tell us and we'll arrange it.

Title: Senior Data Analyst
Description:
We are seeking experienced data analysts to join our teams providing data and intelligence across the shipping and energy industries. We deliver actionable data-driven insights across diverse global shipping, trade, offshore, renewables and energy datasets. You will have the opportunity to build on your data analytics skills, and develop deep knowledge in a dynamic and fast-paced industry that sits at the heart of the world economy.




What you’ll be doing:

Use the latest data science tools and techniques for data processing, analysis and visualisation of large, complex data sets
Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements, plan deliverables, and track implementation with analysts, data engineers and developers
Incorporate advanced AI and algorithms where relevant
Lead implementation of ETL and processing pipelines, data derivation and analysis
Work across teams, support clients and report progress to senior management

You’ll need to have:

3-4 years’ data analytics experience working with complex data models
Ability to update technical and non-technical stakeholders on progress on projects
Experience supervising junior analysts, data engineers and developers
Excellent SQL skills including complex queries, stored procedures and spatial
Working knowledge of Python, JSON and DAX
Ability to deliver actionable insights clearly using visualisation tools such as Power BI
Strong numerical, data handling and analytical skills
A degree in a relevant numerate or analytical subject
Good organisational skills and strong attention to detail

We love to see:

Curiosity and willingness to learn new techniques, programming languages and software tools
Appreciation of the wider data science technology landscape including Databricks
Awareness of global trade, economics and statistics




Details:

Salary: Competitive (dependent on experience) plus bonus and benefits

Location: London/Midlands/Hybrid

Number of vacancies: 1-2

Start date: Q3 2026

Closing date: 13th September 2026 (applications accepted and reviewed immediately)




Working at Clarksons Research:

Clarksons Research is the leading global provider of intelligence and research across shipping, trade, offshore and energy. Respected worldwide, the Clarksons Research team of over 175 experts provides powerful analysis, insight, and data through a range of online platforms, reports, valuations, and consultancy work. Clarksons Research is part of the Clarksons Group, the world’s leading integrated shipping services provider and a FTSE 250 company.




Clarksons Research is currently offering exciting opportunities for experienced senior data analysts to join its expanding Analytics team. Successful candidates will join a fast-expanding business offering excellent opportunities for career progression within a supportive organisation with a strong track record of training, mentoring and ensuring people reach their full potential. We offer a competitive range of benefits including 25-days holiday, corporate pension scheme, gym and health programmes, cycle-to-work scheme and season ticket loans.




Think you’d be a good fit?

Send a CV and cover letter to Apeksha Mehta at recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512.




We also accept applications via LinkedIn though priority is given to applications received by email. Candidates with prior shipping industry experience are encouraged to contact us via email; we would be happy to arrange a discussion with a senior manager or director to explore opportunities for more experienced hires and how your background could best fit within the business.




To prioritise your application for immediate review or to highlight relevant maritime or energy industry experience, please send a CV and letter to recruitment.crs@clarksons.com quoting reference CRSL/RES/512. 




For more information about us, have a look at clarksons.net/about-us and clarksons.com/research




What to expect from us: We believe in human insights and all applications are reviewed by real people, not algorithms. We know your time is valuable and aim to keep to a two-stage process where possible.
