Title: Data Analyst
Company: NICE - National Institute for Health and Care Excellence
Description:
Do you want to do meaningful work that makes a genuine difference to society?

Our main purpose here at The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) is to improve health and wellbeing by putting science and evidence at the heart of health and care decision making. As an organisation we all collaborate to achieve this same goal through empowering our workforce to do great things!

The Business Management Unit (BMU) supports the Medicines Evaluation Directorate in delivering guidance to the NHS and patients by overseeing and managing data, information, processes, business operations, and stakeholder relationships.

Please note that this role may not be eligible for sponsorship under the Skilled Worker route. Please refer to the Direct Gov website for further information regarding eligibility.

Please note this vacancy may be closed early if sufficient suitable applications are received so we encourage an early application.

As part of our commitment to supporting colleagues who are at risk of redundancy, we operate a redeployment process. Candidates who are registered as “at risk” redeployees will be given priority consideration for this vacancy in line with organisational policy.

All applications from redeployees will be reviewed before any external applications are progressed.

The Data Analyst will play a key role in supporting the team’s data management needs, focusing on the extraction, cleaning, quality assurance, and reporting of data to enable effective decision-making and operational delivery. The post-holder will work closely with colleagues across the BMU and wider organisation to ensure data is accurate, accessible, and presented in a clear and actionable format.

Key Duties Include


Extract, clean, and quality assure data from multiple sources, ensuring accuracy and consistency.
Develop, maintain, and update databases, spreadsheets, and records systems, primarily using Excel and Power BI.
Prepare, analyse, and present regular and ad hoc reports for internal and external audiences, including dashboards and visualisations in Power BI.
Support the team in the migration and standardisation of data, including preparation for system transitions (e.g., from Excel to project management tools).
Assist in the development and documentation of standard operating procedures for data handling and reporting.


To Do This, You’ll Need


Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including advanced functions for data manipulation and analysis.
Experience with Power BI for data visualisation and reporting.
Ability to extract, clean, and quality assure data from multiple sources


We are passionate and proud of the work we do and the impact we make. NICE offer:


Generous NHS Pension – Secure your future with one of the most rewarding pension schemes in the UK
Flexible working – Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with options like remote working, compressed hours and flexible start/finish times
Exclusive discounts – Save on shopping, dining and more with a Blue Light Card Time to recharge – Start with 27 days’ annual leave plus bank holidays
Inclusive staff networks – Join supportive communities like Women in NICE, Race Equality Network, Disability Advocacy and NICE and Proud – we celebrate diversity
Tailored development – Grow your career with personalised learning and development opportunities


If you feel this is the type of environment you will enjoy working in, apply today!

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
EXL (NASDAQ: EXLS) is a global data and artificial intelligence ("AI") company that offers services and solutions to reinvent client business models, drive better outcomes and unlock growth with speed. EXL harnesses the power of data, AI, and deep industry knowledge to transform businesses, including the world’s leading corporations in industries including insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, media and retail, among others. EXL was founded in 1999 with the core values of innovation, collaboration, excellence, integrity and respect.

We are headquartered in New York and have more than 60,000 employees spanning six continents. For more information, visit www.exlservice.com.




Role Title: Data Analyst

BU/Segment: Analytics

Location: London, United Kingdom (Hybrid working 3 days a week in the client office)

Employment Type: Permanent




Summary of the role:

EXL is looking for a Data Analyst with a passion for sports who will play a key role in providing analytics support to a client within our Sports, Media and Entertainment practice. Based in London, the role sits within the International Fan Data & Analytics team, supporting fanbase growth and engagement across international markets.




The primary responsibility of this role is to turn large, complex fan datasets into clear insights that help business stakeholders make better decisions. Working hands-on with SQL, Python and cloud data platforms such as Databricks, AWS and Snowflake, you will build the analysis, reporting and audience segments that power international marketing campaigns and track performance against growth goals. You will work with a dynamic team and will have real ownership of, and impact on, the analysis and data products you deliver.




The ideal candidate brings 2–5 years of analytics experience, strong technical skills and an understanding of the fan lifecycle, combined with the ability to translate business questions into well-structured analysis, explain findings clearly to non-technical audiences, and work closely with marketing, international and data engineering teams to deliver measurable value.

If you’re a passionate sports fan who enjoys solving problems with data – and you thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments – we’d love to connect.




As part of your duties, you will be responsible for:

Data Analysis

Write efficient SQL and Python to extract, clean, transform and analyse large fan and marketing datasets.
Work within cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, AWS) to build and maintain analytical datasets and workflows.
Take a business question, develop an analysis plan, and deliver an answer that addresses it.
Summarise large data outputs into clear, business-friendly takeaways for stakeholders.




Reporting & Performance Tracking

Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports on fan growth, engagement and lifecycle metrics across international markets.
Monitor campaign and go-to-market (GTM) performance using agreed KPIs and success criteria.
Contribute to regular performance updates for team leads and senior stakeholders.

Hastings Direct have a number of exciting opportunities for curious, creative and data-driven characters to dive into Insurance Pricing – identifying opportunities to improve how we assess risk to give a fairer price to our customers and thinking laterally about how we approach our work.

However far we delve into the data, we feel it’s important to keep sight of the bigger picture. We’re looking for people who are comfortable and confident with numerical and statistical information, that are able to explain what they are seeing with a range of detail.

You will be at the forefront of developing and evolving sophisticated, segmented pricing across our insurance products.

Everything we do starts and ends with data, whether that be drawing insights, exploring new ways of how we use it or finding value to change it. 
You’ll be collaborating with other areas of our Pricing Data & Analytics teams to bring new data sources to life.

You have experience using Python, SQL or R and have seen projects through from start to finish in a fast moving, data focussed environment.
You’re curious when it comes to data, and comfortable tackling numerical and statistical problems. 
You’ll enjoy mentoring and developing talented Graduate & Junior Analysts.

Title: Water Resources Planning Specialist
Description:
Joining ARUP




Arup’s purpose, shared values and collaborative approach has set us apart for 80 years, guiding how we shape a better world.




We work across the entire water cycle, with utilities, local and regional governments, commercial and domestic water users and other partners. From designing and maintaining key water infrastructure to advising on natural catchments and flood defences, we help clients to consider the long-term economic, environmental and social dimensions of their proposals.




The opportunity




We are seeking a Water Resources Planning Specialist to join our growing Water Resources team, supporting water companies to develop resilient, sustainable and evidence-based plans to meet future water needs.




Water resources planning is central to responding to climate change, population growth, environmental protection and long-term resilience. Working across Water Resource Management Plans, Drought Plans, regional planning studies and Strategic Resource Options, you will help clients make informed decisions about future water supplies, drought resilience and investment priorities.




This is primarily a technical specialist role, rather than a project management position. You will take ownership of defined technical work packages, working alongside specialists in hydrology, environmental assessment, economics, engineering and digital delivery to develop robust planning evidence and clear recommendations.




The Role Will Focus On




Water resources planning, strategy development and supply-demand balance assessment.
Drought resilience, adaptive planning and climate change scenario testing.
Water resources modelling, data analysis and interpretation of planning evidence.
Option appraisal, best-value planning and Strategic Resource Options.
Environmental and regulatory assessment, including SEA, HRA and WFD-related inputs.
Clear technical reporting, client workshops, consultations and regulatory submissions.




Is this role right for you?




If you have all or some of the skills and experience below, and a passion for making a difference in the water sector - we’d love to hear from you.




Experience in water resources planning, water company planning, hydrology, environmental assessment or a related discipline.
A degree, or equivalent experience, in water resources, civil engineering, environmental engineering, geography, environmental science, hydrology or a related subject.
Understanding of WRMPs, Drought Plans, supply-demand balance assessment and resilience planning.
Strong numerical, analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience analysing technical or environmental datasets.
Ability to prepare clear technical reports and communicate complex information simply.
Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to work collaboratively within multidisciplinary teams.




Desirable

Experience supporting SROs or regional planning studies.
Knowledge of water resources and drought planning guidance, including relevant methods and emerging issues.
Knowledge of climate change adaptation, adaptive planning, options appraisal or best-value planning.
Understanding of SEA, HRA or WFD.
Experience with GIS, spatial analysis, digital delivery, regulatory submissions or consultation.
Chartered status, or progress towards chartership, with CIWEM, ICE or another relevant institution.




You do not need to meet every requirement to apply. If you bring relevant experience, strong analytical skills and a willingness to keep learning, we would like to hear from you.




This role is intended for an established technical professional who is developing recognised expertise in water resources planning. You will lead defined technical work packages, provide high-quality planning advice and contribute to major water resources programmes, with support from senior specialists and project managers on overall project leadership and commercial management.




Please note, to ensure we remain GDPR compliant do not send your CV directly to us via this email.




What We Offer You




At Arup, we care about each member’s success, so we can grow together.




Guided by our values, we provide an attractive total reward package that recognises the contribution of each of our members to our shared success. As well as competitive, fair and equitable pay, we offer a career in which all of our members can belong, grow and thrive – through benefits that support health and wellbeing, a wide range of learning opportunities and many possibilities to have an impact through the work they do.




We are owned in trust on behalf of our members, giving us the freedom, with personal responsibility, to set our own direction and choose work that aligns with our purpose and adds to Arup’s legacy. Our members collaborate on ambitious projects to deliver remarkable outcomes for our clients and communities. Profit Share is a key part of our reward, enabling members to share in the results of our collective efforts.




We also provide Private medical insurance, Life assurance, Accident insurance and Income protection cover. In addition, you’ll have access to flexible benefits to help you look after all aspects of your wellbeing and give you the freedom and flexibility to find the best solutions for you, your family, and your individual needs.




Different people, shared values




Arup is an equal opportunity employer that actively promotes and nurtures a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of age (within legal limits), gender identity or expression, marital status, disability, neurotype or mental health, race or ethnicity, faith or belief, sexual orientation, socioeconomic background, and whether you’re pregnant or on family leave. We are an open environment that embraces diverse experiences, perspectives, and ideas – this drives our excellence.




Guided by our values and alignment with the UN Sustainable Development Goals, we create and contribute to equitable spaces and systems, while cultivating a sense of belonging for all. Our internal employee networks support our inclusive culture: from race, ethnicity and cross-cultural working to gender equity and LGBTQ+ and disability inclusion – we aim to create a space for you to express yourself and make a positive difference. Discover more about life at Arup at www.arup.com/careers/your-life-at-arup




We are committed to making our recruitment process and workplaces accessible to all candidates. Please contact maria.mindrut@arup.com to let us know if you need any assistance or reasonable adjustments throughout your application or interview process, and/or to perform the essential functions of the role. We will do everything we can to support you.




Our Application Process




To understand what to expect next, please visit https://www.arup.com/careers/arup-careers-uk-application-process




Stay safe online – Arup will never ask for your bank details as part of our recruitment process.

Recruitment Agencies - We have a Preferred Supplier List of trusted partners to assist us when required and do not acknowledge any speculative CVs or unsolicited candidate introductions from agencies not on the list.

Title: Associate AI Data Engineer
Description:
Role Purpose

Location- Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom

Level - Associate

Department - Product R&D

Working Pattern - Remote

Benefits - Benefits at Ideagen

Salary - £32k - £48k Dependent On Experience.

At Ideagen, we're on a mission to embed AI at the heart of our products and create smarter experiences for customers around the world.

As an Associate AI Data Engineer, you'll help build the data foundations that power these innovations. From developing scalable data pipelines to preparing and governing AI-ready datasets, you'll play a key role in enabling machine learning, automation and generative AI solutions across our product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone looking to accelerate their career in data engineering while gaining exposure to real-world AI challenges. You'll work with modern technologies, collaborate with highly skilled engineers, and contribute to projects that are helping shape the next generation of AI-powered products at Ideagen.

Responsibilities


Building scalable data pipelines that power AI models, machine learning workflows, and intelligent product features.
Transforming large and complex datasets into trusted, high-quality, AI-ready data assets.
Developing ETL/ELT solutions using Python, SQL, AWS, and modern data engineering practices.
Improving data quality, monitoring, governance, and reliability across data platforms.
Contributing to innovative AI initiatives, including dataset versioning, labelling workflows, and AI-powered automation.
Collaborating with AI engineers, software engineers, and product teams to solve complex technical challenges.
Exploring new technologies and helping evolve the platforms that support Ideagen's AI strategy.


Skills And Experience


Experience building and maintaining data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, or data integration solutions.
Strong Python and SQL skills with the ability to develop, troubleshoot, and optimise data workflows.
Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, or Athena.
Understanding of data quality, validation, monitoring, and governance principles.
Passion for solving complex problems using data, technology, and automation.
Interest or experience in AI, machine learning, MLOps, or large language models would be advantageous.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a desire to learn and grow in a fast-paced AI environment.


About Ideagen

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day - from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.

We’re building a future-ready team, and AI is part of how we work smarter. If you're curious, adaptable and open to using AI to improve how you work, you’ll thrive at Ideagen!

What is next?

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com . All matters will be treated with strict confidence.

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process. Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

Title: Validation Analyst
Description:
Business Validation Analyst




Permanent

Hours: 40 hours per week

Location: Remote initially, however, they are looking to open an office in Nottingham in the future, so you must be able to commute

Positions Available: 3




We’re partnering with a growing specialist technology business to appoint three Business Validation Analysts. The organisation helps mobile networks and messaging providers verify that businesses presenting a branded identity to consumers are legitimate and accurately representing who they claim to be.




Using business records, websites, contact information, brand checks and screening data, the business produces evidence-backed validation decisions for its customers.




This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in merchant onboarding, underwriting, KYB/KYC, financial crime, business information, credit, research or investigations who enjoys conducting detailed research and making well-supported decisions.




The Opportunity

As a Business Validation Analyst, you’ll research and assess businesses to establish their legitimacy and confirm that their identity, trading activity and brand representation are accurate.

The role covers two key stages: pre-validation and validation. You’ll initially receive comprehensive training and support, progressing into the full validation process as your knowledge, confidence and consistency develop.

The technology platform gathers and presents much of the relevant information, but you’ll be responsible for interpreting it, conducting additional research where necessary and applying sound judgement to reach evidence-based conclusions.




Key Responsibilities

During pre-validation, you’ll establish whether an applicant is the registered business it claims to be by:

Checking company records, websites, addresses, contact details and trading names.
Using reliable independent sources to verify the information provided.
Identifying connections between registered businesses, trading names and consumer-facing brands.
Investigating discrepancies across company information, websites, addresses and contact details.
Building a clear and comprehensive evidence trail to support your findings.

As you progress into the wider validation process, you’ll also be responsible for:

Reviewing company records, accounts, ownership structures and directors.
Conducting sanctions, politically exposed persons (PEP) and adverse-media screening.
Reviewing websites, privacy policies, terms and conditions and domain information.
Assessing email addresses, logos and brand names to establish credible connections.
Investigating franchise, group-company and trading-name relationships.
Identifying and investigating gaps, inconsistencies and potential risks.
Making evidence-backed decisions and documenting your findings clearly.
Distinguishing genuine screening matches from unrelated businesses or individuals with similar names.
Escalating complex or uncertain cases to an experienced colleague when required.




About You

You’ll have experience in a role that has required you to research businesses, verify information, assess potential risks and make decisions based on evidence.

Relevant professional backgrounds may include:

Merchant onboarding, underwriting or risk.
KYB, KYC or client onboarding.
Customer Due Diligence (CDD) or Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD).
Anti-Money Laundering (AML) or financial crime.
Business information, credit analysis or credit risk.
Trade credit underwriting.
Fraud investigation or counter-fraud.
Intelligence analysis.
Brand protection.
Trading Standards or a similar investigative environment.

Applications are also welcomed from strong researchers in other professional backgrounds who can demonstrate excellent attention to detail, judgement and written communication skills.

Telecommunications experience is not required.




Key Skills and Attributes

You will be:

Highly analytical, with excellent attention to detail.
Comfortable conducting detailed online research across multiple sources.
Able to assess information objectively and reach well-supported decisions.
Confident identifying inconsistencies and recognising when further investigation is required.
Comfortable working at pace while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
Able to communicate findings clearly and concisely in writing.
Confident using browser-based systems and navigating multiple information sources.
Reliable, discreet and comfortable handling confidential information.
Open to feedback and keen to develop your knowledge across the complete validation process.

French or German language skills would be advantageous, as would experience living or working in France or Germany. Familiarity with local business practices, brands, address formats and naming conventions, or previous experience working with international businesses, would also be beneficial. However, these are not essential requirements.




Why Apply?

This is an opportunity to join a growing specialist technology business at an exciting stage of its development, with increasing activity across the UK, France and Germany.

In return, you’ll benefit from:

Permanent employment.
Remote working initially.
Comprehensive training and ongoing support.
The opportunity to develop specialist expertise across business verification, KYB/KYC, screening, brand validation and investigation.
Scope to progress into broader validation responsibilities and take ownership of increasingly complex cases.
The opportunity to make a direct impact on the quality of decisions produced for customers.
A role within a growing international area of the business.




Nottingham is the preferred location for a potential future base, with Birmingham and the surrounding areas also under consideration. Any future office arrangements remain flexible and there is currently no office-attendance requirement.




We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Job Summary

Join HM Land Registry and help us deliver one of the UK's most significant digital transformation programmes.

As a Data Administrator, you will play an important role in supporting the migration of Local Land Charges data from local authorities into HM Land Registry's digital Local Land Charges Register. Working as part of a supportive national team, you will help transform paper-based records into accurate digital information, ensuring high-quality data is available for customers across England and Wales.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys working with data, has a keen eye for detail, and is looking to develop their administrative and digital skills while contributing to a programme of national importance.

Job Description

The Local Land Charges Register was launched by HM Land Registry to modernise and centralise Local Land Charges information. To support the migration of data from local authorities onto the digital register, we work collaboratively with local authority partners to access, extract, capture and improve data quality.

As a Data Administrator, you will work in both HM Land Registry offices and local authority settings, carrying out a range of administrative and data-focused activities. You will help scan and digitise records, input and validate data, support the creation of spatial information and work alongside local authority colleagues to help resolve data issues.

This role may include regular travel across England and Wales. You should be comfortable travelling nationally and, on occasion, staying away from home during the working week.

Main Duties

As a Data Administrator, You Will:


Provide administrative support to Local Authority Delivery Managers and colleagues across the Local Land Charges Programme.
Bulk scan local authority paper records in line with established procedures and quality standards.
Input Local Land Charges information from scanned images to create accurate digital records.
Support the creation and maintenance of spatial data linked to Local Land Charges records.
Work closely with local authority colleagues to identify and resolve data quality issues.
Identify, investigate and escalate complex data issues to relevant programme teams.
Liaise, under supervision, with suppliers and stakeholders to help coordinate solutions to data-related issues.
Travel to local authority offices to undertake scanning, data input and data cleansing activities.
Ensure data is handled accurately, securely and in accordance with agreed processes.
Contribute to the successful delivery of programme objectives through effective teamwork and collaboration.


What We Offer

The opportunity to contribute to a nationally important digital transformation programme.
Full training to help you develop a strong understanding of Local Land Charges and the work of HM Land Registry.
A supportive and inclusive working environment where everyone is encouraged to succeed.

Title: Head of Revenue Operations
Description:
At Commify, we're not just a company - we're a globally connected team of innovators who love what we do. As a CPaaS leader with 25 years of groundbreaking experience, we're the force behind over 5 billion customer interactions each year, enabling businesses worldwide to connect via advanced channels like SMS, RCS, and complex mobile journeys.

Our culture is our core strength. Operating across the UK, EMEA, the USA, and Australia, we've fostered a truly diverse and connected environment, earning a consistent 4 out of 5 culture score in our employee engagement surveys. You'll join a vibrant team where your diverse experience makes a daily global impact.

We need talented people to grow a global company where everyone feels proud to belong, have a purpose, and do their best to directly shape the digital future.

About The Role:

As Commify continues to consolidate its platforms, brands and standardise its offerings across our core business lines (Applications, API, and ISVs), we are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Head of Revenue Operations. This leadership role is responsible for evolving a traditional commercial operations function into a true revenue operations function, responsible for driving sustainable revenue growth by unifying data, processes, and technology stacks across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success.

Reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer (CRO), you will work closely with our international commercial teams to provide robust sales support and analysis. In partnership with Commercial leaders and the VP of Marketing Transformation, you will manage the end-to-end marketing and sales process, implement commercial best practices across all territories, and establish a single source of truth for performance reporting.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Strategy & Planning: Partner with the CRO to drive GTM planning, sales forecasting, and process improvements across regional teams. Design scalable sales workflows to support UI, API, and ISV revenue streams, while collaborating closely with the VP of Marketing Transformation to align Sales and Marketing and eliminate operational silos.
Compensation & Incentives: Co-design and coordinate competitive sales compensation plans, incentive structures, and quota assignments across all territories.
Reporting, Analytics & Forecasting: Lead the sales forecasting process to ensure regional accuracy and consistency. Deliver unified performance reporting, covering funnel velocity, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and headcount efficiency, directly to the CRO, CMO, and Executive Management Team.
Customer Lifecycle & Operations: Manage the end-to-end lead-to-cash process, setting clear SLAs for lead qualification (MQL/SAL/SQL) and handoffs between Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. Standardise processes across onboarding, renewal forecasting, churn reporting, and account expansion.
Technology, Data & M&A: Serve as business owner for sales technology, BI tools, and AI adoption (assisted forecasting and outreach). Chair the Change Advisory Board (CAB) for CRM and MAP systems, enforce CRM data governance, co-own attribution models with Marketing, and lead sales tech integrations and data migrations for M&A acquisitions.


What You'll Bring:

Experience: 5+ years of senior operational leadership experience in reporting, platform management, and financial planning within a complex B2B SaaS or technology environment.
Commercial Finance: Proven experience in commercial finance or revenue operations within a business-to-business environment.
Analytical Ability: Strong capability to analyse complex sales data and translate insights into actionable commercial recommendations.
Cross-Functional Expertise: Demonstrated success operating across the entire revenue engine (Marketing and Sales) with a technical understanding of digital marketing and e-commerce.
Technical Knowledge: Advanced knowledge of CRM (Salesforce) and experience working with marketing automation platforms (Ideally, Adobe Marketo Engage), tech stack integrations, and data pipeline management.
Transformation & Integration: Experience consolidating disparate CRM platforms and legacy processes, including migrating data for newly acquired businesses.
Stakeholder Leadership: Strong communication skills with a track record of partnering with executive leadership, supporting sales teams, and collaborating across departments.

Core Competencies

AI Literacy & Tool Fluency: Ability to navigate, evaluate, and adopt domain-specific AI tools (e.g. generative text/image tools, enterprise copilots, automated analytics) to streamline daily work.
Workflows & Prompting: Skill in structuring clear inputs and contexts to extract accurate, high-value outputs from AI platforms, converting machine results into actionable business deliverables.
Output Validation & Quality Control: Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, hallucination, bias, relevance, and alignment with organisational standards before final execution.

Required Behaviours & Mindset

Adaptive Curiosity: Actively seeks opportunities to learn new workplace approved tech, experimenting with AI capabilities to solve everyday operational friction.

Data Responsibility & Ethical Awareness: Adheres strictly to company data privacy standards, AI Policy guardrails, ensuring sensitive customer, financial, or IP data is never entered into unvetted tools.

Automation-First Thinking: Regularly identifies repetitive, low-value tasks within their workflow that can be automated or accelerated, redirecting time towards strategic execution.


What We Offer:

(Offerings vary by location, but we can guarantee competitive employee benefits)

£100,000.00 - £115,000.00 per annum depending on experience
Performance Based Bonus
Flexible working 
Generous paid leave
Enhance family leave 
Birthday day off
Mental Health Support through our Wellbeing partner, Calm
Wellbeing leave and a Mental Health First Aider program
Giving back days to help support causes close to your heart
Unlimited professional & personal learning
Total Rewards, including retirement planning, healthcare and life assurance 
And did we mention our epic team socials? We know how to celebrate in style!

Title: Python Developer (Ref: 197891)
Description:
about the role


About Us

Forsyth Barnes are partnering with a leading Nottingham based SaaS organisation on two Python Developer roles.

Job Description

As a Python Developer, you will create and enhance software that underpins secure information services used in demanding, highly controlled environments.

Success will involve delivering dependable code, contributing effectively to iterative planning, and helping technical and non-technical colleagues understand delivery considerations. You will also support design decisions, improve engineering practices, provide technical input to commercial activity, and develop the wider capability of the team through knowledge sharing and mentoring.

Key Responsibilities


Design, develop, and maintain robust Python applications for high-assurance security solutions.
Translate technical requirements into practical implementation plans, estimates, and deliverable work packages.
Produce clear design records, technical documentation, training material, and supporting delivery artefacts.
Review code, documentation, and training content to promote consistency, quality, and compliance with established standards.
Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and other delivery ceremonies.
Investigate customer-reported issues, analyse root causes, and provide effective third-line technical support.
Research emerging approaches and recommend improvements to engineering methods, tools, and team processes.
Share technical insight with sales, marketing, project, and product colleagues to support informed decisions.
Collaborate across product and project functions to achieve agreed technical, commercial, and delivery outcomes.
Contribute to discussions about business risks, operational constraints, profitability, and the wider impact of technical choices.


Requirements


Demonstrable commercial experience developing software with Python.
Ability to contribute across software design, implementation, documentation, testing, and technical support.
Experience working in an iterative or Agile delivery environment, including participation in structured sprint activities.
Capability to investigate complex issues methodically and communicate clear findings and recommendations.
Willingness to support colleagues through technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring.
Eligibility to obtain and maintain the security clearance required for sensitive defence, government, or law enforcement work.
Availability to work from the Nottingham site one to two days each week.


Benefits

Salary is based between £50,000 and £55,000.

Other

The position is based in Nottingham, England, with an expected site presence of one to two days per week. Because the work supports sensitive customers and information, appointment is subject to meeting the applicable security clearance and eligibility requirements.

This is a strong opportunity for a Python developer who wants broader ownership than coding alone, combining hands-on engineering with technical investigation, delivery leadership, and contribution to secure product development. Applications should clearly outline relevant Python experience and any existing or transferable security-cleared background.

Title: User Researcher
Description:
About Dambuster Studios

Originally founded in 1999 as Free Radical Design our ambition and passion comes through as strongly now as when we first began. We are always seeking individuals who can emulate our values - passion, quality, and teamwork - which are embodied in our diverse and inclusive culture.

Even if you’re not sure that you meet all the criteria for a role, don’t be put off from applying - we want to hear from you. Our only requirement is that you work from the UK, and if you’re not here right now we can discuss relocation if the role requires you be on-site frequently (if the role requires this, it’s outlined in the advert below). Our internal Wellbeing Committee and Mental Health First Aiders help ensure that our diversity is championed in a safe environment in our city centre studio.

User Researcher

Dambuster Studios - creators of the number one BAFTA-nominated smash hit Dead Island 2 - has an exciting opportunity for a User Researcher to join our highly talented GamesLab team.

This is an exciting opportunity to grow your user research career in the games industry, work across multiple unreleased and unannounced titles and genres, and develop your practice with support from seasoned experts in a dedicated lab environment.

Please note:


We can only offer this role on a fully studio-based or hybrid basis. If hybrid, you must live within 50 miles of our studio or be willing to relocate to within 50 miles and be able to come into the studio three days per week as a minimum.
You will be required to be on site for the set-up and running of play tests.


Role Overview

We’re looking for someone curious, perceptive, and with a passion for gaming. Working closely with the Senior User Researchers and Data Science team, you will play a pivotal role in the design, implementation, and analysis of play tests across multiple titles. You will help shape study plans, facilitate play tests, analyse evidence, and produce actionable insights.

What We Can Offer You


Core hours 9.30am - 4pm, remaining hours worked flexibly
Relocation support to Nottingham, UK (if required)
Holiday allowance that increases with service (to a maximum of 30 days plus statutory public holidays)
Inclusion into the studio’s annual pay review (effective 1st July) following 12 months service
Company pension contribution that increases with service
Private Medical Insurance via AXA Health, including dental and optical cover
Life Assurance Scheme via Zurich (x3 salary cover)
Company enhanced full pay for maternity leave for the first 26 weeks (to qualifying expectant mothers)
Clear career progression within Dambuster Studios
Studio funded learning and development opportunities
Modern game development environment with the latest technologies
Vibrant, modern city centre location with good transport links
Travel Loan Scheme for Nottingham-based employees
Fully subsidised gym membership with Virgin gym (Nottingham)
Quarterly company funded cross-team events such as our Annual Christmas Party, Summer Family BBQ and Teambuilding activities
Free financial advice
Employee referral bonus scheme
Cycle to work scheme
Weekly office treats, including breakfast on Monday and pastries on Friday


Responsibilities


Define, with support, the objectives and focus of each user test.
Own, with support, the day-to-day planning and delivery of defined qualitative and quantitative research studies, including moderating tests, observing users, analysing findings, and preparing reports.
Own the technical set-up and smooth running of research sessions, as well as proactive maintenance of the lab space and equipment.
Support the development and maintenance of our recruitment database.
Continue to develop research competencies through working with and learning from teammates.
Contribute to improvements in research tools, processes, and practice; stay current with games user research, accessibility, data protection, and relevant industry developments.
Act as a representative of the lab and a research champion to maintain positive relationships with internal and external teams.


Requirements


2+ years of practical experience planning and conducting user research, using qualitative and quantitative methods in a professional, academic, or equivalent applied setting.
A passion for Video Games and the gaming industry.
Strong interpersonal skills, with the ability to build rapport, establish credibility, and adapt communication across cultures.
Excellent written communication skills.
Curiosity, creativity, and enjoyment of solving complex issues.
Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite (including Excel and PowerPoint).
Experience with survey design, user research, and user research theory and methodology (desirable)
Data analysis and visualisation experience (desirable)
Experience with PC gaming, video streaming and/ or editing (desirable)


Equal Opportunities Statement

Dambuster Studios is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Anyone considering their next step in their career journey with Dambuster will receive consideration without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy or maternity or paternity, or membership in any other legally protected category. We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees, and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to apply.

We operate a transparent recruitment process that removes barriers for those who require reasonable adjustments. If you require reasonable adjustments during the recruitment or onboarding process, or if you are successful in securing a position with us, please let us know what we can do to ensure your success.

Title: Senior Technical Analyst - SAP
Description:
Are you looking for an opportunity to shape the future of SAP within a business that is transforming the way technology supports complex projects and operations? We're looking for a Senior Technical Analyst to help drive business improvement, platform modernisation, and the effective use of SAP and related manufacturing systems.

Laing O'Rourke's IT function has renewed its strategy to support the company's ambition to transform the construction industry, making it more sustainable, more productive, and fit for the future.

Technology has a critical role to play in achieving this ambition. Our focus is on applying digital capability in ways that genuinely matter, shaping how complex projects are delivered, how decisions are made, and how innovation improves outcomes for people, communities, and the environment.

Our mission is clear: to create a modern and resilient technology environment where trusted data informs every decision, AI enhances every process, and digital capability enables the organisation to operate with greater scale and productivity.

To deliver this, we are building a different kind of IT function, one that is trusted by the business, forward looking in its thinking, and deeply connected to operational outcomes. We are looking for individuals who are curious, thoughtful, and motivated by contributing to work that has real industry impact.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Technical Analyst, you'll play a key role in shaping how SAP supports business processes, service delivery, and operational performance across the organisation. Acting as the link between business stakeholders and technical delivery teams, you'll translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solutions that deliver measurable value.

Working closely with platform owners, engineers, delivery partners, and business stakeholders, you'll help ensure SAP capabilities are used effectively, processes are simplified, and technology investments remain aligned to long-term business objectives.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand challenges, identify opportunities for improvement, and define business outcomes.
Translate business requirements into clear solution options, platform enhancements, and prioritised delivery plans.
Collaborate with SAP engineers and delivery teams to design solutions that maximise standard SAP functionality and minimise unnecessary customisation.
Support the full delivery lifecycle, from discovery and requirements definition through to testing, deployment, and operational handover.
Identify opportunities to simplify, standardise, automate, and optimise business processes across SAP and associated manufacturing systems.
Contribute to platform roadmaps, capability assessments, process models, governance activities, and future-state designs.
Ensure platform changes support operational readiness and can be effectively adopted by the business.
Promote continuous improvement and support the ongoing evolution of SAP capabilities across the organisation.


Essential Requirements


Strong experience working with SAP ECC6 and/or S/4HANA environments.
Proven expertise across key SAP modules such as SD, QM and PP.
Experience delivering SAP configuration, implementations, upgrades and enhancements.
Solid understanding of SAP technical components including ABAP, interfaces and custom development.
Experience translating business requirements into effective technology solutions and platform improvements.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to balance business needs and technical considerations.
Understanding of enterprise applications, integrations, data flows, security considerations and platform dependencies.
Experience working with stakeholders across both business and IT functions.
Excellent communication, facilitation and documentation skills.


Desirable Requirements


Experience with additional SAP modules including WM, MM, PM, DMS, EPP, MPS, FI/CO or CATS.
Experience working within manufacturing, engineering, construction or other project-based organisations.
Knowledge of SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Fiori and modern SAP architecture concepts.
Experience with SAP integration technologies, APIs, middleware and enterprise integration patterns.
Exposure to Manufacturing Systems, MES, shop-floor technology or operational technology environments.
Experience supporting digital transformation, platform modernisation or large-scale SAP programmes.
Relevant SAP certifications or business analysis qualifications.


What Makes This Role Compelling?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future direction of a critical enterprise platform while working at the intersection of business improvement and technology delivery. You'll influence platform strategy, contribute to digital transformation initiatives and help deliver solutions that improve productivity, standardisation and operational performance across the organisation.

You'll also have the opportunity to broaden your expertise across enterprise architecture, integrations, manufacturing systems, data and emerging technologies, including AI-enabled business capabilities.

About Laing O'Rourke

Laing O'Rourke is an international engineering and construction business known for pushing boundaries in digital engineering, modern methods of construction and sustainable delivery. With more than 150 years of heritage, we are committed to creating environments in which diverse teams can excel and thrive.

Accessibility & Inclusion

We are proud to be part of the Disability Confident scheme. If you meet the essential criteria and would like to be considered through our Offer an Interview scheme, please let us know. We're also happy to provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process.

If you require an alternative format of this advert or need support during the application, please contact: resourcingteam@laingorourke.com

Forecasting Lead - Principal Associate

This is an exciting opportunity to manage a small but mighty team responsible for producing demand forecasting for our Customer Operations area. If you are experienced in using tools and techniques to manipulate data, managing others and interested in Forecasting and Planning, then please read on!

What You’ll Do


Lead a small team to cover the production of all forecasts across operations
Produce medium and long term customer demand forecasts for critical contact centre process areas and oversee the creation of back office operations forecasts
Play a lead role in the creation of our operations budgets and outlook refreshes with Finance, through the provision of future volume demand views
Utilise planning data, models and insight to provide compelling advice and recommendations
Maintain strong, collaborative relationships by engaging stakeholders to become a trusted partner of the operation
Continually improve the quality and accuracy of our forecasts by reviewing tools, assumptions, models and processes

Experience of producing forecasts in an operational environment to deadlines

Experience coaching and managing a small team to maintain engagement and good service to our customers
Fantastic stakeholder management skills and ability to manage multiple stakeholders and effectively

Description:
Nottingham Trent House (95002), United Kingdom, Nottingham, Nottinghamshire

Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Job Title: Finance (FP&A) Analyst

Location: Nottingham - Hybrid

Working Pattern: 3 days in-office (Tuesday-Thursday) and 2 days remote.

Our Mission

We’re on a mission to be a force for good in lending. Throughout our almost 30-year history, we’ve consistently been recognised as a great place to work; in 2026, Capital One was officially ranked 9th in the UK’s Best Workplaces™ list. Hear from our team about what it’s like working at Capital One UK.

About The Role

We are looking for a FP&A analyst to help drive our best-in-class FP&A team. As a team we are responsible for a myriad of critical items, including executive reporting, senior stakeholder engagement, insight-focused analysis of our portfolio, and team enablement (i.e. raising departmental technical aptitude). The role adds value to Finance’s business partnering capability by providing accurate and important information at the right time.

With the support of your manager, you will be responsible for the production of our suite of executive financial reporting and will be working with other Business Partners within the finance team to deliver the key messages for the business. The role also involves partnership with stakeholder teams within the US.

What you’ll do


Synthesising and simplifying financial and non-financial data
Supporting in production of Month End reports; Working with team members and the wider FP&A team to feed into monthly financials review (MFR) meetings and/or other reporting requirements
Supporting delivery of Quarterly Financial reviews and other monthly/quarterly tasks at high quality and within deadlines
Supporting ad hoc reporting requests from leadership
Developing reporting to facilitate monitoring and communication of performance against targets or to support review of outlooks (i.e. forecasts) and budgets
Ensuring reporting reflects the most up-to-date and accurate information available.
Supporting in depth analysis into our portfolio to drive key financial insights


How you’ll be doing it


Utilising all systems and applications relevant to the required outputs of the role (e.g., OneStream, Workday, G-Suite, Microsoft Office).
Investigating new technologies and tools and supporting process improvement workstreams
Using business knowledge to enable work to be focussed on finance priorities
Pushing the envelope of our capabilities via new data and automation
Focusing on key risks and opportunities
Collaborating across finance teams to deliver business outcomes together


What we’re looking for


Functional knowledge of accounting and financial principles (e.g. P&L, budget & forecast etc)
Strong attention to detail and proactive approach to delivering results
Strong analytical skills e.g. outlook variance, overall story, accuracy, spotting errors and asking the right questions
Communication - within and outside Finance. Ability to tailor written and verbal comms as appropriate
Relationship building and stakeholder management with teams internal and external to Finance
Continuous improvement and change-agility mindset
Technical skills/willingness to learn (e.g. familiarity with python, sql, snowflake, AI tools etc) a major plus!


Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our [Nottingham / London] office.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft.

What’s in it for you

We invest in the growth of our people alongside our business. You will have extensive opportunities to learn and develop your career, including access to up to £5,000 in funding for external qualifications.

Benefits

In addition to career development, our comprehensive benefits package is designed to grow with you, ensuring your wellbeing is prioritised at every stage of your career:


Wealth & Future: Competitive pension and performance-based bonus schemes
Holidays: Start with 25 days of annual leave, increasing with tenure. Need more? You have the option to buy 5 additional days.
Health: Access premium care through our private medical insurance.
Family Support: We champion your milestones with enhanced parental leave.


A full list of our benefits is available here.

The role adds value to Finance’s business partnering capability by providing accurate and important information at the right time.

With the support of your manager, you will be responsible for the production of our suite of executive financial reporting and will be working with other Business Partners within the finance team to deliver the key messages for the business. The role also involves partnership with stakeholder teams within the US.

What you’ll do

  • Synthesising and simplifying financial and non-financial data
  • Supporting in production of Month End reports; Working with team members and the wider FP&A team to feed into monthly financials review (MFR) meetings and/or other reporting requirements
  • Supporting delivery of Quarterly Financial reviews and other monthly/quarterly tasks at high quality and within deadlines
  • Supporting ad hoc reporting requests from leadership
  • Developing reporting to facilitate monitoring and communication of performance against targets or to support review of outlooks (i.e. forecasts) and budgets
  • Ensuring reporting reflects the most up-to-date and accurate information available.
  • Supporting in depth analysis into our portfolio to drive key financial insights

How you’ll be doing it

  • Utilising all systems and applications relevant to the required outputs of the role (e.g., OneStream, Workday, G-Suite, Microsoft Office).
  • Investigating new technologies and tools and supporting process improvement workstreams
  • Using business knowledge to enable work to be focussed on finance priorities
  • Pushing the envelope of our capabilities via new data and automation
  • Focusing on key risks and opportunities
  • Collaborating across finance teams to deliver business outcomes together

What we’re looking for

  • Functional knowledge of accounting and financial principles (e.g. P&L, budget & forecast etc)
  • Strong attention to detail and proactive approach to delivering results
  • Strong analytical skills e.g. outlook variance, overall story, accuracy, spotting errors and asking the right questions
  • Communication - within and outside Finance. Ability to tailor written and verbal comms as appropriate
  • Relationship building and stakeholder management with teams internal and external to Finance
  • Continuous improvement and change-agility mindset
  • Technical skills/willingness to learn (e.g. familiarity with python, sql, snowflake, AI tools etc) a major plus!

Where and how you'll work

This is a permanent position based in our [Nottingham / London] office.

We embrace a hybrid approach to work. You'll spend three days a week in the office (Tuesday-Thursday), with Monday and Friday being dedicated work-from-home days.

Our offices are designed to inspire and support you. At our Nottingham head office, you'll find an on-site gym, restaurant and dedicated Learning Loft.

Title: Revenue Systems Enablement Partner
Description:
Role Purpose

Location- Ruddington, Nottinghamshire

Level - Experienced Professional

Department - Revenue

Working Pattern - Hybrid

Benefits - Benefits At Ideagen

Salary - To be discussed at next stage

The best GTM tech stack in the world is useless if nobody uses it properly.

At Ideagen, we're investing heavily in the systems that power our commercial organisation. Salesforce, CPQ, forecasting, sales engagement, automation, AI and more. But technology doesn't create outcomes. Adoption does. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Revenue Systems Enablement Partner to be the conduit between the people building our revenue systems and the people relying on them every day. You'll be the person who ensures our sales teams don't just have access to great technology, but actually understand it, use it and get value from it. Bringing complexity into clarity and make systems stick which enables revenue teams to perform at their best.

Responsibilities

You'll sit at the heart of our Revenue Operations organisation, partnering closely with RevTech, Enablement and commercial leaders across the globe. Here's some of what you can get stuck into:


Own onboarding and system enablement across our GTM technology stack
Build training, documentation and self-service resources people actually want to use
Drive adoption of Salesforce, CPQ, sales engagement and forecasting tools
Ensure new starters become system-confident, quickly
Prepare the business for system releases, changes and new functionality
Use adoption data to identify friction, coaching opportunities and process improvements
Act as the first line of support for system usage questions
Reduce reliance on tribal knowledge by documenting critical workflows and processes
Help our commercial teams embrace AI-powered ways of working


Skills And Experience

You'll thrive here if you...

✔ Love making complex things simple

✔ Get a genuine kick out of helping people succeed

✔ Spot adoption problems before they become performance problems

✔ Believe documentation is a competitive advantage

✔ Enjoy working across teams without needing formal authority

✔ Care as much about user experience as system capability

✔ Are curious about how AI can improve productivity, effectiveness and decision-making

What We're Looking For

We're less interested in job titles and more interested in capability.

You Might Currently Work In


Revenue Operations
Sales Operations
Revenue Enablement
Systems Enablement
GTM Technology
CRM Administration
Commercial Excellence


What matters is that you've successfully helped people adopt technology in a fast-moving SaaS or technology environment.

Ideally You'll Bring


Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms
Knowledge of GTM systems and commercial workflows
Strong training and documentation skills
Experience driving system adoption and user engagement
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills
A passion for improving how teams work through better processes and technology


Bonus points if you've worked with CPQ, Clari, Outreach, Salesloft or enablement platforms.

About Ideagen

Ideagen is the invisible force behind many things we rely on every day - from keeping airplanes soaring in the sky, to ensuring the food on our tables is safe, to helping doctors and nurses care for the sick. So, when you think of Ideagen, think of it as the silent teammate that's always working behind the scenes to help those people who make our lives safer and better. Everyday, millions of people are kept safe using Ideagen software. We have offices all over the world including America, Australia, Malaysia and India with people doing lots of different and exciting jobs.

We’re building a future-ready team, and AI is part of how we work smarter. If you're curious, adaptable and open to using AI to improve how you work, you’ll thrive at Ideagen!

What is next?

If your application meets the requirements for this role, our Talent Acquisition team will be in touch to guide you through the next steps.

To ensure a flexible and inclusive process, please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments by contacting us at recruitment@ideagen.com . All matters will be treated with strict confidence.

At Ideagen, we value the importance of work-life balance and welcome candidates seeking flexible arrangements. If this is something you are interested in, please let us know during the application process. Enhance your career and make the world a safer place!

Title: Proposition Manager
Description:
"At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."




Klipboard provides specialist software, services and support to deliver fully integrated trading and business management solutions to companies in the distributive trade – wherever they are in the world. With a unique depth of knowledge and experience in ERP/SaaS solutions, Klipboard has a wide range of clients includes wholesalers, distributors, merchants and retailers from small traders to multinational enterprises. Klipboard has offices in the UK, Ireland, The Netherlands, South Africa, Kenya and North America. Our mission is simple: to design and deliver high performance, integrated ERP solutions that enable our distributive trade customers to source effectively, stock efficiently, sell profitably and service competitively.




Klipboard is a global, growing business that embraces AI and emerging technologies to enhance customer outcomes, collaboration, and continuous improvement. We’re looking for people who are curious about or fluid with AI, open to change, and excited to learn how technology can improve the way we work and help our customers which is always supported by strong human insight and communication.




As product marketing manager (PMM) you will tell product’s story to the market. The PMM’s job is to understand the product’s value proposition and turn that information into compelling messages for customers, prospects, and internal audiences. It shall create white papers, case studies, benchmarks, brochures all utilised to support the value proposition. You will work closely with other product and marketing teams to support specific new product releases. In addition, you’ll assist with the development of innovative marketing initiatives designed to support the sales team.




Key Responsibilities:




Product marketing for existing solutions




Create and develop the toolkit available to further support product sales of existing products and ensure updates are made in a timely manner:

Developing user and buyer personas
Researching the market to learn the competitive environment
Working with the marketing team to create materials that highlight product features and benefits
Training the sales teams on articulating the products’ benefits to prospects
Assist with the creation and delivery of demand creation initiatives to generate awareness of the value propositions across Klipboard product range
Work with appropriate teams to develop high-level sales tools (such as case studies, references and white papers or event support for the regional marketing teams)
Working with the marketing team to create materials that highlight product features and benefits
Internal announcements to the regional teams to ensure new information is released in a timely manner
Ensures all new materials and release information are available




Support New Product releases




Working from the agreed product release plan, collaborate with the appropriate teams to prepare a range of sales tools in preparation of product launches, which will vary depending on the product
Value proposition – Lead how to develop and write a strong value proposition and articulate why it is beneficial to our target market and potential customers




Skills, Knowledge and Experience:




Degree educated in, marketing, product development or a business-related field
A blend of marketing finesse, strategic thinking and product understanding
Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively convey product value propositions to both internal and external audiences
Ability to understand technical software products and translate feature sets into value for customers
Collaboration; work closely with cross-functional teams such as product development, sales, marketing and customer support to align with overall business goals and strategy
Bring creative ideas for product positioning, messaging and promotional campaigns that stand out in the market
Proficient in data analysis to measure the success of content strategy, understand customer behaviour and make informed recommendations and decisions
Ability to quickly grasp and understand the features and benefits of our products to be marketed focussing on unique selling points
Previous experience in product marketing, especially in a product-focused role
Familiarly with the ERP industry and the target audience




Company Info

You may also have seen from our recent posts that we are excited to begin sharing our new company name – Klipboard. Kerridge Commercial Systems (KCS) is becoming Klipboard and our new brand is designed to bring together our expertise across distribution, automotive, retail, rental, transport management, manufacturing, and field service management. We have offices based across the world and we are looking for talented individuals to join our growing teams. Due to our growth over the last few years it is an exciting time to join us as we enter our next chapter! At Klipboard we've introduced a flexible hybrid work policy, where employees spend three days in the office and two days working from home. This approach promotes a balanced work environment that combines office collaboration with the comfort and convenience of remote work."




Equal Opportunities

As a global company, we value and respect the diversity of our workforce, aiming to empower everyone to embrace each other's differences. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where diversity, equity, and inclusion are integral to our company and culture. We recognize the benefits of a diverse workforce, where creativity and valuing differences enable us all to thrive and sparks innovation.




If you require any help, adjustments and/or support during the interview and offer process then please advise our TA or HR team.




Research shows that women and other underrepresented groups are less likely to apply for a role unless they meet every listed requirement. However, we recognise that skills and experience come in many forms, and we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every criterion. If you are passionate about this role and believe you have the right mindset and transferrable skills, we would love to hear from you!




To all recruitment agencies: Klipboard does not accept agency speculative resumes. At present we only accept CV’s from Agencies on our PSL who have been assigned specific position/s. Please do not forward resumes to our careers site or direct to Klipboard employee as this does not constitute an introduction and Klipboard retrospectively will not be liable for any candidate ownership or fees related to unsolicited resumes.
